source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Follow the ordinary first-and-when construction without changing it to before to resolve chronology.
key_decisions.before: This was the first registration while Quirinius was governing Syria.
key_decisions.after: This was the first registration, when Quirinius was governing Syria.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: This was the first registration, taken while Quirinius was governing Syria.

key_decisions.rationale: Retain the marriage pledge and pregnancy without substituting wife from another reading.
key_decisions.before: He went to be registered with Mary, who was pledged to him in marriage and was expecting a child.
key_decisions.after: He went to register with Mary, who was pledged in marriage to him and was expecting a child.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He went to be registered with Mary, to whom he was pledged, and who was expecting a child.

key_decisions.rationale: Retain firstborn, wrapping, and manger; use guest room with a note on the broader lodging sense.
key_decisions.before: She gave birth to her firstborn son, wrapped him in strips of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no place for them in the guest room.
key_decisions.after: She bore her firstborn son, wrapped him in cloths, and laid him in a manger, because there was no space for them in the guest room.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: She gave birth to her firstborn child, wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no place for them in the guest room.

key_decisions.rationale: Keep the emphatic good news and joy while preserving the singular collective people.
key_decisions.before: But the angel said, “Do not be afraid. Look—I am announcing good news to you, great joy that will be for all the people.
key_decisions.after: The angel said, “Do not be afraid. I bring you good news of great joy for all the people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The angel said to them, “Do not be afraid; for see—I am bringing you good news of great joy for all the people.

key_decisions.rationale: Retain today, for you, birthplace, and all three titles without merging Savior and Messiah.
key_decisions.before: Today a Savior has been born for you in David’s town, who is Christ the Lord.
key_decisions.after: Today in David's town a Savior has been born for you: the Messiah, the Lord.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: To you is born this day, in the city of David, a Savior, who is the Messiah, the Lord.

key_decisions.rationale: Follow the genitive favor reading, keeping God's favor rather than making goodwill a human qualification.
key_decisions.before: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace among people of his favor.”
key_decisions.after: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace among those he favors!”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: “Glory to God in the highest heaven, and on earth peace among those whom God favors.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keep the plural their and the presentation purpose rather than correct the source to Mary's purification alone.
key_decisions.before: When the days of their purification according to Moses’ law were completed, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord,
key_decisions.after: When the days of their purification under the law of Moses were complete, they brought Jesus up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

key_decisions.rationale: Retain the master/slave relationship and present release without making the words an explicit request for death.
key_decisions.before: “Now, Master, you are releasing your servant in peace, according to your word,
key_decisions.after: “Now, Master, you are releasing your slave in peace, just as you said,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: “Now, Sovereign Lord, you are dismissing your servant in peace, according to your word;

key_decisions.rationale: Keep Gentiles and Israel as distinct, joined recipients of light and glory.
key_decisions.before: a light for revelation to the nations and glory for your people Israel.”
key_decisions.after: a light for revelation to the Gentiles and glory for your people Israel.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: a light for revelation to the nations and for glory to your people Israel.”

key_decisions.rationale: Follow the pinned source's father and mother rather than replace father with Joseph for harmonization.
key_decisions.before: The child’s father and mother were amazed at what was being said about him.
key_decisions.after: His father and mother were amazed at what was being said about him.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the child’s father and mother were amazed at what was being said about him.

key_decisions.rationale: Retain both falling and rising and the passive appointment without deciding whether the same people undergo both.
key_decisions.before: Simeon blessed them and said to Mary his mother, “Look, this child is appointed for the falling and rising of many in Israel and for a sign that will be opposed—
key_decisions.after: Simeon blessed them and said to Mary, his mother, “This child is appointed for the fall and rising of many in Israel, and as a sign that will be opposed—
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Then Simeon blessed them and said to Mary, his mother, “This child is destined for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and to be a sign that will be opposed,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserve Mary's personal wound and the revelation clause without supplying a specific future event.
key_decisions.before: and a sword will pierce your own life too—so that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
key_decisions.after: and a sword will pierce your own soul too—so that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that the inner thoughts of many will be revealed— and a sword will pierce your own soul also.”

key_decisions.rationale: Render eighty-four as her age while recording the possible duration of widowhood; retain constant temple service.
key_decisions.before: and then as a widow until the age of eighty-four. She never left the temple, serving God with fasting and prayer night and day.
key_decisions.after: and she was now a widow of eighty-four. She never left the temple, serving God night and day with fasting and prayer.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and then as a widow to the age of eighty-four. She never left the temple, but worshiped there with fasting and prayer night and day.

key_decisions.rationale: Keep physical growth, wisdom, and favor without adding in spirit from a variant.
key_decisions.before: The child grew and became strong, filled with wisdom, and God’s favor was upon him.
key_decisions.after: The child grew strong and was filled with wisdom, and God's favor was upon him.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The child grew and became strong, filled with wisdom; and the favor of God was upon him.

key_decisions.rationale: Retain the two questions, necessity, and father contrast; document the alternative Father's affairs construction.
key_decisions.before: He said to them, “Why were you searching for me? Did you not know that I must be in my Father’s house?”
key_decisions.after: He answered, “Why were you searching for me? Did you not know that I must be in my Father's house?”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He said to them, “Why were you searching for me? Did you not know that I must be in my Father’s house?”

key_decisions.rationale: Keep the threefold development and both divine and human favor, noting the age/stature range.
key_decisions.before: Jesus grew in wisdom and stature and in favor with God and people.
key_decisions.after: Jesus continued to grow in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And Jesus grew in wisdom and in stature, and in favor with God and with people.
